sourceText:
My super simple stuffed mushrooms
By: Gaila Perez
Published: Friday, April 17, 2015 - 11:44am

Ingredients




1 package of baby portobello mushrooms
3 garlic cloves, sliced into small cubes
3 tablespoons of parsley, chopped
3 tablespoons of olive oil
2 tablespoons of bread crumbs

Preparation

1 Pre-heat the oven 350 F. 2 Clean the mushrooms, take out the stems and chop them into small cubes. In a small sauce pan heat a tablespoon of olive oil and add the chopped garlic and mushrooms, cook for 2 - 3 minutes, season well with salt and pepper, add the parsley. Take of the flames and then add the bread crumbs. 3 In a baking tray put the mushrooms upside down and fill the middle with the garlic and mushrooms, sprinkle with the olive oil and salt and pepper. 4 Bake for 15 minutes, serve right away

About

Super simple to make and delicious to taste. Will go wonderfully with meats, fish or with vegetarian dishes as well, what more can you ask for? not much really. So Follow this effortless recipe and you won't regret.
